cells.rationale: The 10-year yield has been trending down from early-October highs above 5.3% and closed at 4.986% on Oct 26, with the latest reading at 4.99% on Oct 27. The yield is currently just below 5.00% and has fallen about 30 bp over the past month. With a busy week of Fed, GDP, and PCE data ahead, but the prevailing trend pointing lower, the probability of a print above 5.00% on Oct 30 is modest but not negligible given potential event-driven volatility.

note: Judge panel member forecasting from Claude's evidence brief before each cutoff; scored as a separate method.
